items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1957-03-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you know Brownlee? Norman Brownlee? He might have been after your time. [INTERVIEWEE] Brownlee?

ctx.x: Anything else you want to... I was wondering about those fellas from across the river like Brownlee. Did you know Brownlee? Norman Brownlee? He might have been after your time.
